integrity: Analytic proof plus reproducible exact finite-state rational checks; priority comparison is bounded to identifiable published material; no independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Rate-one asynchronous coalescing walks on a star with full initial occupancy only; no claim for synchronous jumps, two-opinion initial states, or growing hub sets. Near-origin limiting transform domain is sufficient, not asserted sharp.
title: Exact star-coalescence transform and its non-Gumbel logarithmic limit
